## What Changes and Why?

Describe the user-visible result and link related issues. Use Closes #123 only when fully resolved.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results, including local ZIP processing and affected exports. State what could not be tested.

## Accessibility and User Impact

For UI changes, record keyboard/focus, accessible names, screen-reader, theme, contrast, forced-colours, zoom/reflow, and reduced-motion checks as applicable. For exports, consider structure, reading order, tables, links, and diagram alternatives. Automated checks alone do not establish conformance.

## Limitations

Describe trade-offs, Windows/Electron-specific behaviour, remaining barriers, and follow-up work.

## Checklist

- [ ] Read the [contributing guide](https://github.com/Hart365/PP-MD/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/Hart365/PP-MD/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [ ] Keep changes focused, without generated builds, customer files, exports, credentials, or personal data.
- [ ] Record relevant checks and unverified combinations above.
- [ ] Update regression tests and documentation, or explain why not needed.
